meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查你电脑里 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的安装情况，和最新源码对比，给出一份带 PASS/WARN/FAIL 结论的报告，每条结论都附上命令输出或文件作为证据。诊断期间不改动你的配置，只提出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求做安装健康检查或医生检查，提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词，或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常、怀疑安装过期损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 的安装是否正常，和最新版对比一下。
say.note: 会生成一份带 PASS/WARN/FAIL 结论的健康报告。

say.text: Codex 更新后行为有点怪，帮我诊断是不是装坏了。
say.note: 会核对插件、配置和命令链接是否与最新源码一致。

say.text: 给本地 Codex 做个只读体检，不要改我的配置。
say.note: 只读检查，给修复建议；动手修改前会先征求同意。

howto.what_en: Audits local LazyCodex/Codex install vs latest sources; emits a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence per verdict. Read-only: never mutates install/config/repos; remediations proposed, applied only if the user later asks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user asks for a health check, mentions LazyCodex/lazycodex-ai/omo-codex, or reports Codex acting oddly after install/update/config change, or suspects stale/broken setup.

say_en.text: Check my LazyCodex install is healthy and up to date.
say_en.note: Outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: Codex is acting oddly after an update; diagnose whether it is broken.
say_en.note: Claude inspects plugin, config, and bin links.

say_en.text: Run a read-only doctor check on my Codex setup, changing nothing.
say_en.note: It will propose fixes and ask before applying.
